cards.ex: She's on the fast track to becoming a CEO before she's 40.
cards.exUz: U 40 yoshga to'lmasdan bosh direktor bo'lishning tez yo'lida.
cards.uzDef: Karyerada tez rivojlanish, yuqori lavozimlarga tez erishish.

cards.ex: He's been climbing the corporate ladder for the past decade.
cards.exUz: U so'nggi o'n yillikda korporativ zinapoyadan ko'tarildi.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyadagi lavozimlar ierarxiyasi, mansab pillapoyalari.

cards.ex: The career prospects in the tech industry are excellent right now.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi vaqtda texnologiya sohasida karyera istiqbollari juda yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakdagi ish imkoniyatlari, karyera o'sishi istiqbollari.

cards.ex: They found a niche market for handmade pet sweaters.
cards.exUz: Ular qo'lda tikilgan uy hayvonlari uchun sviterlar uchun tor bozor topishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik, aniq belgilangan iste'molchilar guruhiga mo'ljallangan bozor.

cards.ex: Job satisfaction is more important to me than a high salary.
cards.exUz: Menga yuqori maoshdan ko'ra ishdan qoniqish muhimroq.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan olinadigan rohat, qoniqish hissi.

cards.ex: Finding a good work-life balance is crucial for mental health.
cards.exUz: Ruhiy salomatlik uchun yaxshi ish-hayot muvozanatini topish juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Ish va shaxsiy hayot o'rtasidagi sog'lom muvozanat.

cards.ex: After years in a corporate job, she decided to go freelance.
cards.exUz: Korporativ ishda yillardan so'ng, u frilansga o'tishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z-o'ziga ishlaydigan, mustaqil mutaxassis bo'lish.

cards.ex: He was on the dole for six months after losing his job.
cards.exUz: U ishini yo'qotgandan so'ng olti oy davomida nafaqada edi.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy nafaqa olib yashash, ishsizlik nafaqasi.

cards.ex: They managed to land a lucrative contract with a major client.
cards.exUz: Ular yirik mijoz bilan foydali shartnoma olishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror loyiha yoki ish uchun shartnoma imzolash.

cards.ex: It's crunch time at the office; we're working late every night.
cards.exUz: Ofisda eng qizg'in payt; biz har kecha kechgacha ishlayapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Loyiha yoki ishning eng qizg'in, eng stressli payti.

cards.ex: The company is trying to get rid of some of the dead wood.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya ba'zi ortiqcha xodimlardan xalos bo'lishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz, samarasiz xodimlar.

cards.ex: Her strong work ethic is what makes her so successful.
cards.exUz: Uning kuchli mehnat axloqi uni shu qadar muvaffaqiyatli qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Ishga bo'lgan munosabat, mehnatsevarlik, mas'uliyat hissi.

cards.ex: He received a generous golden handshake when he retired.
cards.exUz: U nafaqaga chiqqanida saxiy oltin qo'l siqish oldi.
cards.uzDef: Kattaroq pul to'lash bilan ishdan bo'shatish.

cards.ex: I'm tired of the nine-to-five; I need a change.
cards.exUz: Men to'qqizdan beshgacha bo'lgan ishdan charchadim; menga o'zgarish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, ofisda ishlaydigan ish soatlari.

cards.ex: As the boss, she gets to call the shots around here.
cards.exUz: Boshliq sifatida u bu yerda qaror qabul qilish huquqiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Biror vaziyatda asosiy qarorlarni qabul qilish huquqiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: His job is on the line if he doesn't improve his performance.
cards.exUz: Agar u ishlashini yaxshilamasa, uning ishi xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Xavf ostida bo'lish, yo'qotish xavfi ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: This job is just a stepping stone to my dream career.
cards.exUz: Bu ish mening orzularimdagi karyeraga faqat bir tramplin.
cards.uzDef: Kattaroq maqsadga erishish uchun bir bosqich.

cards.ex: She shattered the glass ceiling and became the first female CEO.
cards.exUz: U shisha shiftni sindirdi va birinchi ayol bosh direktor bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ayollar yoki ozchiliklarning yuqori lavozimlarga ko'tarilishiga to'sqinlik qiluvchi yashirin to'siq.

cards.ex: Losing the contract was a tough break for the company.
cards.exUz: Shartnomani yo'qotish kompaniya uchun og'ir zarba bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Omadsizlik, nohaqlik, achinarli vaziyat.

cards.ex: They're trying to corner the market with their innovative product.
cards.exUz: Ular o'zlarining innovatsion mahsulotlari bilan bozorni egallashga harakat qilmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Bozorning katta qismini nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: The negotiations are getting tough; they're starting to play hardball.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar qiyinlashmoqda; ular qattiq kurasha boshladilar.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq, murosasiz taktikalar bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He made a killing in the stock market last year.
cards.exUz: U o'tgan yili fond bozorida katta daromad qildi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va oson pul ishlash, katta foyda olish.

cards.ex: The promotion is up for grabs; anyone can apply.
cards.exUz: Lavozim ko'tarilishi qo'lga kiritish mumkin; har kim ariza topshirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Har kim olishi mumkin, ochiq, hech kimga tegishli emas.

cards.ex: We've put that project on the back burner for now.
cards.exUz: Biz hozircha bu loyihani keyinga qoldirdik.
cards.uzDef: Hozircha muhim bo'lmagan, keyinroq ko'rib chiqiladigan narsa.

cards.ex: An internship is a great way to get a foot in the door.
cards.exUz: Amaliyot - bu sohada ish boshlashning ajoyib usuli.
cards.term: get a foot in the door
cards.uzDef: Biror sohada yoki kompaniyada ishlash uchun birinchi imkoniyatni qo'lga kiritish.

cards.ex: After years of hard work, he finally landed a plum job.
cards.exUz: Yillar davomidagi mehnatdan so'ng, u nihoyat yaxshi ish topdi.
cards.uzDef: Ajoyib, qulay va yaxshi to'lanadigan ish topish.

cards.ex: He's always wanted a white-collar job in finance.
cards.exUz: U har doim moliya sohasida ofis ishini xohlagan.
cards.uzDef: Ofisda ishlaydigan, aqliy mehnat bilan bog'liq ish.

cards.ex: My grandfather worked a blue-collar job at the factory.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom fabrikada ishchi kasbida ishlagan.
cards.uzDef: Qo'l mehnati bilan bog'liq, ko'pincha jismoniy mehnat talab qiladigan ish.

cards.ex: She decided to take the plunge and start her own business.
cards.exUz: U qat'iy qadam tashlashga va o'z biznesini boshlashga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki xavfli bo'lishiga qaramay, biror narsaga qaror qilish va harakatga o'tish.

cards.ex: The corporate culture here is very supportive and collaborative.
cards.exUz: Bu yerdagi korporativ madaniyat juda qo'llab-quvvatlovchi va hamkorlikka asoslangan.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyadagi odatlar, qadriyatlar va munosabatlar to'plami.
